author: KEXP
description: Dublin outfit Gurriers serve a cathartic expression of post-punk in our latest in-studio session. With host DJ Abbie, the band share a fiery performance of "Approachable" and more.
title: Gurriers perform '"Approachable" & more Live on KEXP
